tokens.name: void
tokens.usage: SCREEN. The page background, every screen.

tokens.name: raise
tokens.usage: SCREEN. Cards, tiles and row panels sitting on the page.

tokens.name: raise2
tokens.usage: SCREEN. Anything floating above the page: sheets, dialogs, fields, the Segmented track, icon circles.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: SCREEN. 1 px hairlines between rows and around inline cards. Never behind words.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: SCREEN. All primary words and active icons. 18.11:1 on void, 15.95:1 on raise2.

tokens.name: text2
tokens.usage: SCREEN. All secondary words: subtitles, meta, captions, timestamps, inactive labels. 7.95:1 on void, 6.79:1 on raise2.

tokens.name: hot
tokens.usage: SCREEN. The accent, as a fill: played heat bars, badges, the active-tab dot, the accent button. Words on it are void (at least 6.30:1). Follows the listener's accent choice.

tokens.name: hotText
tokens.usage: SCREEN. The accent, as words or icons on dark: links, tappable subtitles, liked hearts, error text. At least 7.44:1 on void (8.46 in Sunrise) and 6.36:1 on raise2.

tokens.name: hotSoft
tokens.usage: SCREEN. The accent at 16 %: behind a soft timestamp chip or a play glyph. Words on it are hotText.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: SCREEN. Success, always beside a word or icon. 11.46:1 on void.

tokens.name: warn
tokens.usage: SCREEN. Warning, always beside a word or icon. 11.52:1 on void.

tokens.name: comp-idle
tokens.usage: COMPONENT (TabBar). Idle tab icons only, never words. 4.51:1. Code name: idle.

tokens.name: comp-placeholder
tokens.usage: COMPONENT (Field). Placeholder text in a field only. 4.96:1 on raise2. Code name: text3.

tokens.name: comp-violet
tokens.usage: COMPONENT (HeatCurve, NowBar). The far end of the accent gradient. Never words. Code name: violet.

tokens.name: comp-barIdle
tokens.usage: COMPONENT (HeatCurve). Unplayed bars and the scrubber track; 3.73:1 because the curve carries information. Code name: barIdle.

tokens.name: comp-glass
tokens.usage: COMPONENT (NowBar). The bar's glass over a 30 blur. Code name: glass.

tokens.name: comp-glassLine
tokens.usage: COMPONENT (NowBar). The 1 px edge round the glass. Code name: glassLine.

tokens.name: comp-outline
tokens.usage: COMPONENT (Button, secondary). The 1.5 px ring. 4.86:1 on void. Code name: outline.

tokens.name: comp-scrim
tokens.usage: COMPONENT (Sheet). Dims the page behind a sheet or dialog. Code name: scrim.

tokens.name: comp-toastAction
tokens.usage: COMPONENT (Toast). The action word on the light toast, 5.92:1. Code name: toastAction.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The page title in every title bar. The only title size: a long title shrinks to fit. Replaces hero, the 26/28 overrides.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Every other heading: the title bar once scrolled, sheet and dialog titles, empty-state titles, a heading inside a page. Same size as Apple's Title 3 (20/25). Replaces title 22, statement 24, heading 20, lede 18.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: A big number that is the point of a card: the Saved moments count, Hot now. Replaces figure and the 40 count.

styles.name: strong
styles.usage: Anything people tap or scan for: row, card and tile titles, names, button words, chip words, the now bar title, section heads. Replaces row, section 17, compact 14, chip 12.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Anything people read in full: comments, descriptions, toasts. Replaces body, quote, note.
styles.sample: This is the part where the tone shifts.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Supporting words: subtitles, meta lines, Reply, the line under an empty-state title. Always text2 unless tappable (then hotText). Replaces caption.

styles.name: time
styles.usage: Times, durations and counts: 0:05 / 1:00, a timestamp chip, a badge. Replaces mono, badge.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: The smallest text (Apple's minimum is 11): episode tags, field labels, row details, and the rail labels (ME, TODAY) in capitals. Replaces tag and the Unbounded edge label.

spacing.note: Six steps. Inside a component: 4, 8, 12. A card's padding: 16. Between blocks: 24. Between regions: 32. The screen gutter is its own constant.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to its word; inside a badge.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and its subtitle; between chips; between buttons in a row.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between items in a row or card; between tiles in a grid.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Padding inside every card, panel and sheet body.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between blocks on a page.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between regions of a page; above an empty state.

tokens.name: gutter
tokens.usage: Left and right edge of every screen (16 on phones narrower than 375 pt).

radius.note: Three radii and a pill. Pick by what the thing is, never by taste.

tokens.name: radius-s
tokens.usage: Small things: timestamp chips, covers up to 64 pt.

tokens.name: radius-m
tokens.usage: Things in a list or bar: row panels, comment cards, fields, the now bar, toasts, artwork.

tokens.name: radius-l
tokens.usage: Things that stand alone: cards, Me tiles, dialogs, sheet tops, big covers.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, Segmented, circles, badges.

size.note: Fixed frames. Text inside grows with the reader's text size; these are minimums.

tokens.name: size-tap
tokens.usage: The minimum frame for anything tappable (Apple: 44 × 44 pt). Icon circles, Back, More, a toast's action.

tokens.name: size-button
tokens.usage: Every button's height.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Every list row, and every field.

tokens.name: size-bar
tokens.usage: The tab bar and the now bar.

tokens.name: size-play
tokens.usage: A play disc (inside a 44 frame).

shadow.note: Glows only, in the accent. Nothing in Pulse casts a shadow.

tokens.name: glow-dot
tokens.usage: The active tab's dot.

tokens.name: glow-bar
tokens.usage: Heat-curve bars in a hot range.
